title: Conformal Field Theory Realizations of Subfactors
exact_target: Realize every finite-index subfactor in conformal theory and seek a direct construction from its data.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004278 (OWR-17292-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Subfactors and Applications (2019), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2019/49, pp. 3053--3140. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 9.
Jones, Does every subfactor arise in conformal field theory (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Bischoff, CFT realization of quantum doubles for index below four (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: This is related to ID 30002833 and contains the Asaeda--Haagerup instance, ID 30002840. The finite-index and constructive wording prevents asserting exact equivalence of these extracted records without matching the original realization notions.
